title: Card Game Ecosystem Problem Space Map
description: What people who play, collect, sell, make and work around card games are trying to get done, from 6,346 recounted moments by 1,605 accounts, with the products they name.
note: Hierarchy and people counts are from a purpose graph of 6,346 recounted moments by 1,605 accounts (public posts and videos on Reddit, YouTube, note.com, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and others, plus five interviews), grouped by model readers and reviewed by model reviewers; only tasks raised by four or more people are shown (210 of 1,444). Satisfaction is scored, not measured: a model scored each person from 0 to 10 on how well the task goes for them, from that person's own statements with the supporting statement recorded, and the task shows the mean. Products are the ones people named using for the task, at most four a task; four well-known ones were added and are not from the accounts. Nothing was checked by a person.
